secondary_skills.instructions: How many of these supplied items are mentioned or unambiguously described in the CV: Excel; SQL (also accept: T-SQL; Transact-SQL); Power BI? Count each item once. A generic category or related activity does not establish a specific product or skill. This is document coverage, not proficiency.

sql_evidence.instructions: What is the strongest explicit evidence for SQL (also accept: T-SQL; Transact-SQL) in the CV? Classify evidence context, not proficiency. A list-only mention is not a concrete application; do not infer professional use from nearby employment history.
